entry.name: Deep Learning Specialization
entry.note: Five courses from dense networks through sequence models; the standard second step

reading.format: Five courses with video lectures, quizzes, and ungraded labs; implementation in Python and TensorFlow.
reading.summary: The Deep Learning Specialization is a five-course foundational program created and taught by Andrew Ng. It covers building and training neural networks from the ground up, including convolutional networks, sequence models, and transformers. Finishing the program shows the ability to implement deep learning models in Python and TensorFlow and to apply techniques like hyperparameter tuning and error diagnosis.
reading.audience: The page says it is for anyone who wants a rigorous foundation in deep learning, including software engineers moving into AI, data scientists, and early-career or aspiring machine learning engineers.
reading.prerequisites: Comfortable with Python and basic linear algebra. Prior machine learning experience helps but is not required.
